english.note: Use this when emphasizing the quick act of directing your eyes toward something rather than inspecting it.

examples.english: I heard a sound at the door, so I gave the doorway one quick glance and went back into the room.
examples.traditional: 聽到門口有聲，我望一眼就返入房。
examples.jyutping: teng1 dou2 mun4 hau2 jau5 seng1 ngo5 mong6 jat1 ngaan5 zau6 faan1 jap6 fong2
